case_title: Subodh Nath and Anr. v. State of Tripura
neutral_facts: The accused, Subodh Nath and Paritosh, were prosecuted for the killing of Ashutosh. The prosecution case was supported by the testimony of an eyewitness, PW-13, who stated that the accused assaulted the deceased with an axe and a lathi, and that the accused later shot the deceased with a gun. PW-13 fled the scene due to fear of the accused. The evidence of PW-13 was corroborated by PW-6, who found the deceased and the accused grazing cows in the jungle. The Investigating Officer recovered an axe handle near the deceased's body. The trial court convicted both accused under s.302/34 IPC, and the High Court upheld the conviction. However, the Supreme Court remitted the case of Paritosh to the Juvenile Justice Board as he was under 18 at the time of the offence, and acquitted Subodh Nath based on the corroborated evidence.
